class.warrior.weapons: Ready your war cry! Now, on to choosing your weapon...

class.mage.blurb: Fragile, but magic goes straight through armour.
class.mage.weapons: A shrewd pick for experienced players! Now, on to choosing your magic...
class.assassin.name: Assassin
class.assassin.blurb: Fast and deadly: criticals on a 19 or 20.
class.assassin.weapons: Perfect for quick, silent kills! Onwards to choosing your knives...

item.ironSword.desc: Plain, reliable and well balanced. Gets the job done.
item.arturiasSword.desc: A huge blade with a faint glow in the dark. The Warrior's original weapon, since 2023.
item.apprenticeWand.desc: A stick with a blue stone on the end. The masters swear it's more than that.
item.largeStaff.desc: Too big for any reasonable purpose. Takes both hands and half the room.
item.doransKnife.desc: Small and quick. Always finds a gap in the armour.
item.shojinBlade.desc: Curved, light, with a red ribbon nobody knows the point of.
item.graniteHammer.desc: A chunk of the Golem on a handle. Weighs like a regret.
item.doransShield.desc: Iron, wood and a crest nobody recognises.
item.woodenShield.desc: Planks nailed together with faith. Better than nothing.
item.apprenticeRobe.desc: Blue, with stitched stars. Keeps out the cold and nothing else.
item.leatherArmor.desc: Tanned and hand-stitched. Doesn't slow you down.
item.chainShirt.desc: Thousands of iron rings. Makes a pleasant jingle when you walk.
item.plateArmor.desc: Dozens of steel plates. They'll hear you coming a mile off, but little gets through.
item.shadowCloak.desc: Torn from the Mysterious Shadow. Still cold to the touch, and it seems to move on its own.
item.ironHelm.desc: Dented on one side. Its last owner learned the hard way.
item.wizardHat.desc: Pointy and blue. They say the magic is in the hat. They say.
item.steelGreaves.desc: They protect your shins. Running in them is another story.
item.travelerBoots.desc: They've seen more roads than you have. Light and quiet.
item.doransRing.desc: A gold ring with a red stone that warms up when you cast.
item.greaterPotion.desc: Purple, thick and bubbling. Don't ask what's in it.
item.rustyMace.desc: More rust than mace. Still, nobody likes being hit with it.
item.watchmanSpear.desc: It belonged to a guard who watched over the abandoned city to the very end. The ribbon is still red.
item.thornvaldAxe.desc: Thornvald used to say no door could stand against him. Nor walls. Nor tables.
item.boneStaff.desc: Topped with a skull that sometimes seems to smile. Best not to think about it.
item.emberWand.desc: The tip never cools down. Careful where you put it.
item.moonglassDagger.desc: Forged under a full moon. Weighs almost nothing and cuts moonlight itself.
item.namelessBlade.desc: Nobody remembers who forged it, or how many fell before it. It whispers when you draw it.
item.ironBuckler.desc: Small and quick. Turns blows aside instead of taking them.
item.wornGrimoire.desc: Half the pages are torn out and the other half are in no known language. Works anyway.
item.scarletBandana.desc: Protects nothing, but makes you look like you know what you're doing.
item.ravenHood.desc: Dark as a moonless night. Your steps grow light beneath it.
item.guardianHelm.desc: A helm of the old royal guard, cracked but proud. The plume survived everything.
item.forgottenCrown.desc: Nobody remembers the king's name. The crown remembers everything.
item.paddedJerkin.desc: More patches than gambeson. Warm and honest.
item.vessarBreastplate.desc: Bronze from the forges of Vessar, engraved with a sun nobody worships any more.
item.astralTunic.desc: The stitched stars move around when you're not looking.
item.studdedLeggings.desc: Thick leather with iron studs. Noisy, but they hold.
item.greywolfRing.desc: A blue stone on a dull silver band. At night you hear howling in the distance.
item.emberSeal.desc: A gold signet with an ember trapped inside. Still warm.
item.minorPotion.desc: Not much, but it works. Tastes like cough syrup.
item.mistTonic.desc: Pale blue and cold as the morning fog.

game.over: [red]Game over.[/] Your legacy ends here... for now.
cave.awake:
[amber]{name}[/], you wake up in a dark cave with no idea how you got there.
In the distance you see a light that looks like a way out.

Keep going?
cave.refuse: Ummm... I don't think we're getting out of here any time soon like this...
cave.chest: On the way you trip over a half-buried chest. The lock gives in to a kick. Inside:
skeleton.intro:
Great. As you reach the end of the cave, you run into a [red]Skeleton[/] that, by the looks of it, wants you dead.
That not being great, you'll have to fight it!
skeleton.won:
Excellent, you killed the skeleton! Must have had osteoporosis.[pause]

haha...[pause]

no...?[pause]

ok...[pause]

sorry.

Moving on!
merchant.intro:
At the mouth of the cave, by a campfire, a hooded merchant sits on a cart full of junk.
"A survivor! That's worth a discount... a small one."
city.question:
As you leave the cave you come face to face with a vast city that seems to be abandoned.

Do you want to explore it?
city.shadow:
As you head deeper into the city, you spot a strange shadow floating in the distance.
When you get closer to see what's going on, it nearly kills you with a spear that pierces the side of your chest.

You'll have to fight the [red]Mysterious Shadow[/]!
forest.golem:
Okay then. You leave the city behind and, walking through the forest, you find a pile of rocks and sit on it to rest for a bit.
The rock stands up... and it doesn't look very happy with you.

You'll have to fight the [red]Stone Golem[/]!
chapter.end:
[gold]End of Chapter I[/]

For the rest of the story, you'll have to wait a little longer!
